name: WMT2025 General MT — blind test set
description: WMT2025 General MT blind test set, fetched on demand via sacreBLEU (`sacrebleu -t wmt25 -l <pair> --echo src,ref`; pinned sacreBLEU 2.6.0). One of the field's canonical HELD-OUT blind sets — the clean tier that complements our public dev splits. Covers several genres (news, social, speech, literary). Scored against the PRIMARY reference (ref[0]); each sacreBLEU langpair is a distinct directed corpus (en-de → eng→deu, de-en → deu→eng). Domain 'mixed' with an APPROXIMATE domainDistribution (the General MT task spans genres; exact per-segment proportions are not published).

download.instructions: Fetched on demand via sacreBLEU: `sacrebleu -t wmt25 -l <langpair> --echo src,ref` (pinned sacreBLEU 2.6.0). sacreBLEU verifies the upstream archive md5; Champollion never hosts the content.

source.citation: Findings of the 2025 Conference on Machine Translation (WMT25). statmt.org/wmt25.

license.aiTraining: Released for research evaluation; not licensed for unrestricted AI training. doNotTrain protects benchmark integrity.
license.notes: WMT shared-task test data is distributed for RESEARCH use; the references are professionally produced but the underlying sources and terms are not blanket-permissive. Tagged commercial=false / redistribution=false so it stays out of every prize, commercial, and API lane (license_use.py). Champollion never hosts the content — sacreBLEU fetches it from source on demand. transmissionPolicy 'no-train' (founder decision 2026-07-19, docs/IP_TRANSMISSION_REVIEW_2026-07-19.md §6): WMT distributes these test sets FOR research evaluation — evaluation is the license's stated purpose, so remote model-API evaluation proceeds without a per-dataset upstream ask, restricted to no-train channels (docs/DATA_BOUNDARIES.md §'Transmission to model APIs').

usageRestrictions.communityNotes: Held-out WMT benchmark: training on it defeats its purpose. Research-use license — kept out of every commercial / prize / API lane; the content is fetched from source, never hosted.

contamination.reasoning: WMT25 General MT blind test set — the freshest WMT edition and explicitly DIFFICULTY-SAMPLED ('Time to Stop Evaluating on Easy Test Sets', Kocmi et al., ACL 2025, 2025.wmt-1.22). The cleanest absolute-rankable tier; graded LOW + freshBlindTestSet so it rides the absolute-quality lane. (Catalogue-only until the installed sacreBLEU bundles it — see quarantine.)

_provenance.populatedFrom: sacreBLEU 2.6.0 DATASETS['wmt25']; per-pair size = built segment count, sha256 = sha of the deterministic built corpus. Generated by build_wmt_general_cards.py.

quarantineReason: WMT25 is not bundled in sacreBLEU 2.6.0; pairs are PROVISIONAL (the WMT24 continuation set, unpinned). Catalogue-only until a later sacreBLEU ships wmt25 — then re-run build_wmt_general_cards.py to pin real pairs + drop this flag.
